title: Giant third-order polarization rotation via wave-mixing-induced symmetry breaking in a Rydberg-EIT medium
summary: We investigate how wave-mixing (WM)-induced symmetry breaking leads to giant third-order polarization rotation of a weak probe field in a Rydberg electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) medium. A far-detuned counterpropagating WM field is adiabatically eliminated and retained solely as a Raman dressing of the lower Zeeman manifold. In this reduced description, the weak static magnetic field defines the two circular propagation channels, while the WM-induced Raman coherence breaks the symmetry between these channels, without acting as a gain channel or an independent nonlinear source.…
